description: OAKLAND — California Attorney General Rob Bonta with the joint effort of local, state, and federal law enforcement partners, today announced the eradication of nearly one million illegally cultivated cannabis plants and 221 arrests in 22 different counties across California in 2026 as part of the Eradication and Prevention of Illicit Cannabis (EPIC) program. By dismantling these illicit grow operations, EPIC is disrupting organized criminal networks, rescuing vulnerable individuals from forced labor, and dismantling the human trafficking operations that exploit workers at remote grow sites.
